planets.name: GJ 1214 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Orkaria with a 1.58-day year, found in 2009.

text.card: GJ 1214 b was found in 2009 by MEarth Project as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Orkaria. Its orbit and size follow Mahajan et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname MAHAJAN_ET_AL__2024): disc_year 2009, disc_facility MEarth Project, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 1.580404531, pl_radj 0.24382235, pl_bmassj 0.02646082

quotes.title: GJ 1214 b
quotes.card: GJ 1214 b is an exoplanet with a very high temperature that orbits the star GJ 1214, discovered in December 2009.
quotes.introduction: Its parent star is 48 light-years (15 pc) from the Sun, in the constellation Ophiuchus.
